transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay, Friday standup. Quick. Andre, dyno?

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: dyno is warming up now. the first run should start in like 10 min. the load cell cable i re-routed, so should be quiet

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good. Also, spin coupling, we need 6 by 10/7. Zoe, that's for your fixture, right?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: yeah the spin test fixture. i have the shaft, just not the coupling. i think they said its in transit but not sure

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Nothing on the dock as of yesterday!!

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: nothing this morning either i just checked

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK. Let's follow up. Luis, status on the guard?

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: guard is welded, i just need to paint it. should be dry by mon

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: *monday. the guard is for the spin fixture btw

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: If I could restate where we are on the build side. 1. The sub assemblies are ready. 2. We are waiting on a couple of the test fixtures. 3. I'd like to know if anything else is holding up the tests.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Nothing else that I know of.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: i need to recheck the torque transducer calibration, it's been a while. i can do it eow, or, um, thurs of next week

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Do it sooner. Before the spin test.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Weekend plans anyone? I'm going to take the dog to the beach if the fog clears.

transcript.speaker: p-andre
transcript.text: going hiking if my knee lets me lol

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: nothing planned

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: Sounds nice. Back to work for a second, I'd like a list of what each of you thinks is at risk next week.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: One more, for the record, we need that order by 10/6. The test slot is fixed. Everything depends on it!!

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: got it. ill chase it today

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: ill help

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Alright, thanks all.
